BETA Close X Associated British Foods PLC has repurchased 248,516 of its ordinary shares on 11 May 2026, at an average price of GBp 1808.9270 per share, with the highest price paid being GBp 1819.5000 and the lowest at GBp 1803.0000. These shares were purchased from Barclays Capital Securities Limited and are intended for cancellation as part of the company's share repurchase program announced on 25 February 2026. Disclaimer* Associated British Foods PLC 11 May 2026 11 May 2026 Associated British Foods plc Transaction in own shares Associated British Foods plc (the " Company ") announces that on 11 May 2026 it purchased for cancellation from Barclays Capital Securities Limited (" Barclays ") the following number of its ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence each pursuant to the authority granted by its shareholders as part of its share repurchase programme, details of which were announced on 25 February 2026. Description of shares: Associated British Foods plc Ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence Date of transaction: 11 May 2026 Number of shares repurchased: 248,516 Average price paid per share: GBp 1808.9270 Highest price paid per share: GBp 1819.5000 Lowest price paid per share: GBp 1803.0000 The Company intends to cancel these Shares. All shares were purchased from Barclays as an on exchange transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange.
